== Signing your comments ==
To make conversations easier to follow, '''please sign your comments''' on talk pages with 4 tildes: <code><nowiki>--~~~~</nowiki></code>, <code><nowiki>–~~~~</nowiki></code>, or <code><nowiki>~~~~</nowiki></code> are suggested (slight variations are also acceptable; only the 4 tildes are required to produce the signature). This works for ''any'' users (anonymous/unregistered users and registered/logged-in users). If you are [[Special:UserLogin|logged in]], you can change your signature in your [[Special:preferences|preferences]].

== Template usage ==
Please [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Template_substitution subst] this template when signing others' comments.

To do so, type
<pre>{{subst:unsigned|username}}</pre>
This turns into:

{{unsigned|username}}
[[Category:Templates]]
</noinclude>
